title: NZ First condolences with passing of Jim Anderton
content:
7 January 2018

NZ First condolences with passing of Jim Anderton

  • Rt Hon Winston Peters
Deputy Prime Minister

 

Winston Peters

NZ First Leader

Deputy Prime Minister 

7 January 2017

 

New Zealand First expresses condolences with the passing of Jim Anderton

 

 

New Zealand First Leader and Deputy Prime Minister Winston Peters has expressed his condolences with the passing of Jim Anderton.

 

“On behalf of New Zealand First I wish to acknowledge the contribution Jim Anderton has made to the country and his remarkable service as a parliamentarian,” said Mr Peters.

 

“Whatever you thought of his politics Jim stuck to his principles and what he believed in up to the end.”

 

“Our deepest condolences are extended to the Anderton family for their loss,” said Mr Peters.
